notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eight tapped lands.
description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar
